graph_contract.edge_inventory: one east and one south adjacency per logical vertex when that neighbor exists; no duplicates or omissions
graph_contract.topology: all logical cells open, connected, acyclic, and enclosed by a blocked raster border

current_implementation.randomization: Fisher-Yates shuffle of the entire edge vector through the shared PCG32 context
current_implementation.dsu: two-dimensional raster-sized parent storage, recursive path-compressed find, unranked union
current_implementation.termination: considers all E shuffled edges even after the spanning tree has V-1 accepted edges
current_implementation.classification: randomized Kruskal spanning tree; no minimum-weight or uniform-spanning-tree guarantee

verification.tiny_rectangular_corpus: all odd width/height pairs from 3 through 11, seeds 0..15, 400 cases
verification.edge_order_exhaustion: all 24 permutations of the 2x2 logical graph's four edges accepted exactly three edges and connected all four vertices
